posts.title: Revisiting restarting `pulseaudio`
posts.description: OK, so I have recently again started to have problems with PulseAudio vs PipeWire confusing SwayOSD , again. But this time the fix seems simpler! Which is nice. Essentially: disable pulseaudio , enable the rest, and that’s it. The runes this time appear to be: systemctl --user disable pulseaudio.service pulseaudio.socket pulseaudio-x11.service systemctl --user enable pipewire.service pipewire.sock

posts.title: Sabbatical Diary: Every End Had a Start
posts.description: Having set off with a song in my heart I finish with a rather different song playing. No matter. Variety is the spice of life after all.
